## Change and reason

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue or source evidence where useful.

## Verification

State the commands or document checks run, their actual results, and any checks not run. Skipped tests are not qualification evidence.

## Scope

- [ ] Uses synthetic examples and contains no credentials, personal records or private host details.
- [ ] Separates implemented/tested behavior from proposals and simulations.
- [ ] Preserves applicable upstream attribution, licenses and notices.
- [ ] Does not imply product adoption, release or live-execution admission without its evidence.
